name: Missing Clone Call
hint: If the [sbi]When I start as a clone[/sbi] block is used to start a script, but the sprite is never cloned, the event will never be triggered and the script will not be executed.
instruction: If the [sbi]When I start as a clone[/sbi] block is used to start a script, but the sprite is never cloned, the event will never be triggered and the script will not be executed, so make sure that you clone the sprite.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked

when i start as a clone :: #ff0000 // ⇦  🐛
go to (random position v)
next costume

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
create clone of (myself v) :: #007000 // ⇦  👍

when i start as a clone
go to (random position v)
next costume
